provenance: Synthetic. Written for this repository from the published structure of the form and the ordinary shape of departmental practice. No client matter, no real GSTIN, no real taxpayer, officer or reference number. Included because Rule 88C recovery runs under Section 79 without a further notice, which makes the reply window the whole matter.
description: A Rule 88C liability difference caused by a credit note reported in the statement of outward supplies but adjusted a month later in the summary return. Explainable, and dangerous only if the window is missed.
notice_text:
FORM GST DRC-01B
[See rule 88C]
Intimation of difference in liability reported in the statement of
outward supplies and that reported in the return

Reference No : ZD060225440915        Date : 05/02/2025

GSTIN : 06AADCM4417Q1Z8
Name : M/s. MANGLAM AUTO COMPONENTS PRIVATE LIMITED
Address : PLOT 61, SECTOR 6 IMT MANESAR, GURUGRAM - 122052

Tax Period : FY 2024-25
Section under which notice is issued : 75
Date by which reply has to be submitted : 12/02/2025

The difference set out below has been observed for the tax period
stated above. Pay the differential with interest through FORM GST
DRC-03, or furnish an explanation in Part B within seven days.

1. Difference in liability reported in GSTR-1 and discharged in GSTR-3B

   The liability declared in the statement of outward supplies exceeds the liability discharged in the summary return for the said period by more than the limit prescribed under Rule 88C.

   Particulars                                   CGST           SGST         IGST       CESS           Total
   Difference                             74,300.00     74,300.00          0.00          0.00      148,600.00

Where neither is done, the amount shall be recoverable under Section
79 without further notice, and the statement of outward supplies for
the succeeding period shall not be available for filing.

Proper Officer
Name : ANIL KHURANA
Designation : Excise and Taxation Officer
Jurisdiction : WARD 3 GURUGRAM EAST , GURUGRAM , Haryana

intake.issues: 1. Difference in liability reported in GSTR-1 and discharged in GSTR-3B
intake.facts: Auto components supplier. A credit note for a rejected consignment was reported in the statement of outward supplies for the month but the corresponding reduction was taken in the summary return of the following month. Net liability across the two months is nil.
intake.documents_available: Credit note with the customer's rejection memo, GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B for both months, ledger extract showing nil net effect

defects.heading: Difference in liability reported in GSTR-1 and discharged in GSTR-3B

expected.notes: Recovery under Section 79 follows automatically if nothing is filed. The deadline, not the argument, is what this case tests.
